Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert incorrectly concluded that Wanda Austin held a C-suite position before joining Apple's Board of Directors. While it is true that Wanda Austin served as the President and CEO of The Aerospace Corporation, she did so after joining Apple's board in 2016. The expert failed to verify the timeline of her C-suite role relative to her appointment to Apple's board. This error led to the incorrect conclusion that all board members held C-suite positions prior to joining, which ultimately resulted in the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
